svg.title: OmacVM Bridge
svg.desc: Animated diagram of OmacVM Bridge. Left: the Mac's screen with the macOS menu bar (display, Wi-Fi and sound icons) and a Dock that holds the Omarchy icon. Right: Omarchy in the VM with its Rose Pine Dawn bar. Between them a link over the VM's private network (10.0.2.2, or 192.168.77.1 on the fast network), secured with a token, carries events. First the Mac's Wi-Fi signal grows from one to three bars and Omarchy's Wi-Fi icon follows, showing the Mac's network. Then AirPods connect to the Mac: the Mac switches its output and Omarchy's audio menu lists the AirPods and selects them. Finally Super+Ctrl+N toggles Omarchy's nightlight: the event travels back to the Mac, Night Shift turns on in the macOS Display panel and the Mac's screen turns warm.

g.text: the Mac's real Wi-Fi, live in Omarchy's bar
Omarchy's nightlight switches the Mac's Night Shift
